info.title: API.SH: Groupon
info.description: The Groupon API from API.SH: public Groupon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.description:
What Groupon's search box suggests for a partial query in a city: suggested searches and matching deals (title, merchant, price, original price, promo code, rating, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-autocomplete

parameters.description: What has been typed so far.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug. Default chicago.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Deals to return (1-30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Groupon's category tree for a city: the top categories (name, slug, page link, number of deals), every subcategory with its number of deals, and the neighbourhoods with deals. Slugs work as the category of `/groupon/v1/deals`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-categories

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug (chicago, new-york, los-angeles, ...). Default chicago.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, instead of location (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude, instead of location (with lat).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Groupon coupon codes for a store
get.description:
The coupon codes, sales and deals Groupon lists for an online store: offer title, type, the visible end of the code, expiry, verified and exclusive flags, how often it was used today and this week, minimum spend and terms; with the store's rating, categories and FAQ.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-coupons

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store as in groupon.com/coupons/<store> (nike, amazon, macys, the-home-depot, ...). store or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A groupon.com/coupons/<store> link, instead of store.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which offers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Groupon deal: options, prices, fine print and ratings
get.description:
One Groupon deal: title, status, merchant (name, website, about, rating and count), price and original price, rating with the 1-5 star distribution, review topics and summary, sold count, purchases in the last 30 days, end date, badges, category and breadcrumbs, highlights, description, fine print, every option (title, price, original price, discount, sold count, status, expiry, quantity limits, promotion, terms, locations) and every redemption location (address, phone, website, coordinates), images and the latest reviews. Pass a deal slug or link, or q (with location or lat/lng) to open the first current deal for a search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-deal

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Deal slug, the groupon.com/deals/<slug> part (e.g. gl-chicago-architecture-boat-tours-2026).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Deal link (instead of slug).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Opens the first current deal for this search (instead of slug).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With q: city slug to search in (default chicago); or pass lat and lng.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: With q: latitude to search around.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: With q: longitude to search around.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Groupon local deals for a city, overall or in one category, on the US site or another country site (`country`: uk, de, au, ie, fr, it, es, nl, be, pl; prices in that site's currency, distances in its unit): the deals the city page lists first (about 9; the site loads more only as you scroll), each with id, title, link, merchant name and its number of locations, merchant location, distance, price, original price, sale and promo-code prices with the code and its end date, discount, rating and count, sponsored flag, the card's badge (e.g. Popular Gift), image, and every purchase option (id, status, price, original, sale and promo prices). `page_url` is the page the site served (a category slug the site does not know falls back to the city page). The deal's category path, sold count and full option details are in `/groupon/v1/deal`. Groupon has no Canadian site any more.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-deals

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug, e.g. chicago, new-york, los-angeles.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug: things-to-do, beauty-and-spas, food-and-drink, health-and-fitness, auto-and-home and others (the other country sites use their own slugs).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Groupon country site (default us). City slugs are that site's, e.g. london, berlin, sydney, dublin, paris.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Groupon deal and its merchant: rating, text, date, option bought, helpful count, reviewer (first name, review and rating counts, badges), photos and merchant replies, with the deal's overall rating, rating count and review topics. Filter by star rating or topic; sort by most recent or most helpful. Pass a deal slug or link, or q (with location or lat/lng) to use the first current deal for a search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-reviews

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Deal slug, the groupon.com/deals/<slug> part.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Deal link (instead of slug).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Uses the first current deal for this search (instead of slug).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With q: city slug to search in (default chicago); or pass lat and lng.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: With q: latitude to search around.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: With q: longitude to search around.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the reviews. Default recent.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only these star ratings, e.g. 1 or 1,2.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Only reviews about one topic from the response's topics list (e.g. guide, staff, price).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50. Default 20.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Groupon deals matching a keyword near a US city or a point: id, title, link, merchant and its rating, price, original price, discount, promo code with its price and end date, cash back, rating and count, badges, closest location with coordinates and the number of locations, images and sponsored flag, plus the facets (brands, categories, locations and more) on the first page. Sort by relevance, price, distance or rating. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/groupon-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug (chicago, new-york, los-angeles, san-francisco, houston, dallas, austin, seattle, denver, atlanta, miami, boston, washington, phoenix, las-vegas and other large US cities). Default chicago. Ignored when lat and lng are given.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to search around (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude to search around (with lat).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the deals. Default relevance.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of deals to skip (the next_offset of the previous page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Deals per page, 1-50. Default 24.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
